posts.cooked:
I thought that was at one point stated as Greatest Legacy's power, and now it is keen eyesight.  It has changed several times.  The first several Pauls used to just be listed as general physical enhancement.

 

What I love best is finding out that my theory to explain Legacy's in game powers was accurate, he can mostly negate one big shot, and adds to that general toughness.

I love the Dune-esque vulnerability to slow moving knives as well.

 

I also love the personality of Legacy in a fight.  Fly right into the center, cause havoc and trust the rest of the team to make things work out well.

Of course, a tactical expert, stealth user and speedster definitely fit well with that strategy.

 

Can't wait to find out more about the Wraith.

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
My understanding:

  • Original timeline: Baron Blade kills Paul, Felicia becomes Legacy and beats him.
  • Iron Legacy timeline: Baron Blade incapacitates Paul temporarily, Felicia becomes Legacy and is promptly killed, Paul goes nuts and kills Blade.
  • Shattered timeline: Unclear.  Next Evolution shows them both in costume in a non-hostile situation, so she at least starts wearing the costume at some point, probably when they go up against Iron Legacy.  She most likely never calls herself Legacy, though.

Which is another question to ask -- does a Parsons get all the powers at once, or do they start with the previous generation's, then develop one later?

posts.name: dpt
posts.cooked:
On another thread, @Powerhound2000 asked where Christopher and Adam talked about the Freedom Six. As a result, I ended up making a table of contents to help future people:

  • 00:00 - Introduction
  • 03:50 - Parsons family overview
  • 07:39 - Particular Parsons, starting from Joseph Parsons to Paul Parsons VIII, the current Legacy
  • 17:27 - Start of the questions
  • 19:55 - DLo Lott's question on Mama Parsons and how she feels about the Legacies going around putting themself in danger
  • 22:30 - Senator Emily Parsons
  • 27:17 - Nielzabub: relations between Paul Parsons VIII and Pauline Felicia Parsons
  • 28:00 - crossing the streams
  • 32:35 - Chris Burton: Relation between Legacy and Iron Legacy, how time travel works
  • around 35:10 - discussion of nature of Iron Legacy event (35:46: "ousted from other world")
  • 36:00 - Nielzabub question, how did relationship change as a result of Iron Legacy
  • 38:44 - David: Who does Legacy trust?

At this point i found what I was looking for. Someone else can fill this in more!
